findings.title: Docstring does not state the sign convention required by spec R5
findings.detail: Spec R5 requires the docstring to make the sign of the result unambiguous (a decrease is negative). The current docstring only says 'fraction'. Add the decrease example `percent_change(200, 150) == -0.25` to the docstring.

findings.title: test_exported could also assert callability
findings.detail: `callable(calc.percent_change)` is a cheap extra assertion; not required.
